examined_formations.title: CHINA_SHENZHEN_10_FTE_POSITIVE_PROFIT_POSITIVE_OCF_FRESH_35_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_PROJECT_CONSULTING_CONTROLLER_RESOURCE_AND_PHYSICAL_SUPPLY_CHAIN_DEPENDENCE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Tianlu Huaxin's 2024 annual report identifies Wen Xianguang as current controlling shareholder and actual controller with 35%.
A 2024-02-06 agreement transferred 6,058,500 shares, 35% of the company, from Ningbo Gaoxin Shenglin Investment Management to Wen Xianguang for RMB1.1511m.

Wen Xianguang started the year with zero shares and ended 2024 with 6,058,500 shares / 35%; the 2024 annual report therefore proves the control transfer was completed no later than 2024 year-end, before 2026 H1.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The current 2026 H1 report discloses 10 employees.
2026 H1 revenue is RMB3,045,201.52, attributable net profit RMB2,318,577.59 and operating cashflow RMB3,886,851.84.
Current total assets are about RMB15.525m, keeping the legal entity small enough to remain useful for a fresh-operator control test.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The disclosed model combines one-time project fees with annual consulting agreements rather than proving a self-serve recurring machine rail.

The business depends on business promotion, enterprise-management consulting and commercial services, with customer acquisition and project allocation performed through management/sales relationships.
The company has expanded into agricultural/supply-chain activity that explicitly uses controlling-shareholder/controller resource advantages and includes physical procurement.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is the first Scan 120 formation to pass current low-FTE, positive-revenue, positive-profit, positive-OCF and completed pre-period fresh-control gates together.

It still does not prove founder-light control cashflow because customer acquisition, project delivery and the newer supply-chain activity depend on human relationships, controller resources and physical operating flow.
The known RMB1.1511m share-transfer price is bounded, but current operating/working-capital needs cannot be reduced to that acquisition consideration once physical supply-chain activity is included.
economic_signal: Current 2026 H1: 10 FTE; revenue RMB3,045,201.52; attributable net profit RMB2,318,577.59; OCF RMB3,886,851.84.
2024 fresh control: 6,058,500 shares / 35%; announced consideration RMB1.1511m; completed by 2024 year-end.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Corporate control is fresh enough to test and economically bounded at the share-transfer layer.

The actual operating control surface is not a transferable software/data right: it is project consulting, management/sales acquisition, relationship allocation and a newer physical supply-chain activity.
Controller-resource integration is disclosed as a strategic operating input rather than being normalized away.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_BEIJING_12_FTE_POSITIVE_PROFIT_POSITIVE_OCF_INTERNET_AD_MEDIA_BUYING_WITH_LONGSTANDING_FOUNDER_FAMILY_CONTROL_NO_FRESH_OPERATOR_TRANSFER
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The 2026 H1 report states that controllers Zhang Wei, Wang Jing and Zhang Zhiyong did not change during the period.
The same controller group is already present in the 2023 annual report.

Company history identifies Zhang Wei as general manager from 2009 and chairman/general manager from 2015, so the current packet is longstanding founder/family control rather than an evidenced fresh operator acquisition.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The 2026 H1 report directly discloses 12 employees.
2026 H1 revenue is RMB97,644,344.98, net profit RMB805,499.59 and operating cashflow RMB4,177,203.45.
Current total assets are about RMB101.439m and current equity about RMB83.916m.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The company provides internet advertising placement and optimization services.
Its delivery model buys advertising/media resources and resells/optimizes placement for advertisers.
The small team and positive cash generation are real, but current control was not acquired by a fresh operator in a reproducible transaction.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Positive current economics and 12 FTE do not prove fresh-operator reproducibility.
The incumbent controller/family group predates the current evidence window by many years.
Media inventory/resource procurement and customer optimization remain contract/platform-dependent operating inputs even if headcount is low.
economic_signal: Current 2026 H1: 12 FTE; revenue RMB97,644,344.98; net profit RMB805,499.59; OCF RMB4,177,203.45.
Controller group remains Zhang Wei / Wang Jing / Zhang Zhiyong and is documented at least as far back as 2023, with Zhang Wei operating the company since 2009.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The current operating company is small-headcount and cash-positive.
No executed fresh-operator control transfer is evidenced; the relevant control position is a longstanding founder/family incumbent.
The economic surface is advertising-resource procurement/placement/optimization rather than a proven transferable machine-only right.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_HEILONGJIANG_8_FTE_POSITIVE_OCF_BUT_ZERO_EXTERNAL_REVENUE_NET_LOSS_NEGATIVE_EQUITY_AND_FINANCIAL_ASSET_HEAVY_SHELL
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The current report provides a reliable current 2026 H1 ledger and directly discloses 8 employees.
No control-history deepening is required because current external revenue and net-profit gates fail first.
The company remains in restructuring/reorientation context rather than showing a normal current operating revenue engine.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current total assets are RMB54,386,304.66, of which trading financial assets are RMB49,286,555.35.
Current net assets attributable to shareholders are negative RMB3,801,975.52.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 operating cashflow is positive RMB288,498.70.
Current operating revenue is exactly RMB0.
Attributable net profit is negative RMB749,371.86; consolidated net profit shown in the income statement is also negative.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Positive OCF alone is not an operating-business pass when same-period external revenue is zero and profit is negative.
The asset base is overwhelmingly trading financial assets rather than a current external customer revenue rail.
Eight employees and positive OCF therefore form a useful false-positive control for the inverted retrieval sequence.
economic_signal: Current 2026 H1: 8 FTE; external revenue RMB0; attributable net loss RMB749,371.86; OCF positive RMB288,498.70.
Trading financial assets RMB49,286,555.35 versus total assets RMB54,386,304.66.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The economic early gate stops before control history.
Positive OCF is not treated as proof of customer cashflow because external revenue is zero.
Financial-asset liquidity is not relabeled as a commercial machine-control surface.

excluded_observations: Scan 060-119 formations and their primary discovery signals were excluded from Scan 120 primary formation selection.
Renying Technology was not deepened because a timely reliable 2025 annual report was unavailable and disclosure delay had already triggered regulatory attention.
Zhengyang, Zhongshi Jiayao, Canyou Shanwu, Yuhuatang, PT Shuixian and other low-FTE current-report observations were stopped at negative current profit or negative OCF.
Huaxia 5 was not used as a primary formation because indexed current-report fields were internally inconsistent across pages; no favorable field was selected from the conflict.
No job, gig, RFQ, procurement or asset-marketplace feed was used as the discovery ontology.
